name: Grupa Kapitalowa IMMOBILE S.A.
summary: Established in Bydgoszcz, Poland, in 1868, Grupa Kapitalowa IMMOBILE S.A. (which operated as MAKRUM S.A. until its renaming in 2014) is a diversified Polish conglomerate. The company's key operational areas across Poland include industrial machinery manufacturing, property development and construction, hotel management, real estate holdings, and retail trade. In the machine industry, the group specializes in producing crushing and grinding equipment crucial for various sectors, such as cement, paper, mining, food processing, energy production, and chemical manufacturing. Its construction and development segment undertakes the design and erection of a wide array of structures, including production halls, warehouses, industrial and commercial facilities, office buildings, shopping centers, supermarkets, and residential properties. This division also provides property development and construction consultancy services. Within the real estate sector, the company owns and manages properties specifically for commercial leasing. The hospitality arm operates a network of hotels situated in major Polish cities, such as Sopot, Poznan, Bydgoszcz, Lódz, Szczecin, Gdansk, Chorzow, and Inowroclaw. Furthermore, Grupa Kapitalowa IMMOBILE S.A. offers general contracting, specialized docking solutions, and advanced automatic parking systems.
